summary: This Form 8-K filed by the depositor of a commercial mortgage-backed securities trust (BANK5 2025-5YR17) reports an administrative servicing change. Under the VRTX 2025-HQ trust and servicing agreement, Situs Holdings was removed as special servicer of the Vertex HQ Mortgage Loan, representing 8.7% of the asset pool, and Argentic Services Company LP was appointed successor. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic transaction occurs; the filing is routine operational disclosure of a servicing appointment under Item 8.01. The registrant acts solely as depositor of the securitization trust, and no shareholder or stakeholder action is implicated. The event does not constitute a special situation; it is a routine current report regarding trust administration.
